summary: On node1 (RHEL 9.8), built a local RPM repository from packages downloaded to local storage, served it over HTTP via a systemd-managed python http.server, blocked the normal remote RHEL/subscription-manager repos at the network level (firewalld REJECT on tcp/443), and installed the `tree` package purely from the local repo while the remote repos were confirmed unreachable. Restored connectivity afterward, then performed the mandatory single-node restart with pre/post health evidence.
actions_performed: Installed createrepo_c while network was still reachable
Downloaded tree-1.8.0-10.el9.x86_64.rpm into /srv/localrepo via dnf download --resolve
Ran createrepo_c on /srv/localrepo to generate repodata
Created and enabled systemd unit localrepo-http.service serving /srv/localrepo via python3 http.server on port 8080
Added firewalld direct REJECT rules for outbound tcp/443 (ipv4+ipv6) to make cdn.redhat.com/subscription.rhsm.redhat.com unreachable, verified via curl
Installed tree with dnf using only localrepo (remote repos disabled) while remote repos were unreachable; verified binary runs and package metadata shows Red Hat build info
Removed the temporary firewalld REJECT rules restoring normal connectivity, verified via curl
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime, localrepo-http service state, repo HTTP 200 check, rpm -q tree, repo file contents
Restarted node1 via backgrounded `systemctl reboot` so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec access returned; confirmed boot_id changed (6aa805ba-5845-488d-af03-a621555936e2 -> b803b58b-0bbe-4fb4-b11b-07ca1200f88a) and uptime reset

Verified post-restart recovery: localrepo-http.service active+enabled, repo HTTP 200, tree still installed and functional, repo file persisted, dnf sees localrepo, firewall direct rules cleared (runtime-only as intended)

evidence.requirement: Local package repository served from local storage on node1
evidence.summary: createrepo_c installed, tree RPM downloaded to /srv/localrepo, createrepo_c generated repodata, systemd service serving it on port 8080 confirmed active with HTTP 200 response
After firewalld REJECT rule on tcp/443, curl to cdn.redhat.com failed with connection refused, proving remote repo endpoint was unreachable

evidence.requirement: Package installed from local repo while remote unreachable
evidence.summary: dnf install tree using only localrepo succeeded (Repository column shows 'localrepo'); rpm -q and tree --version confirm functional install
firewalld direct rules removed; curl to cdn.redhat.com returned HTTP 403 (reachable, auth-denied) instead of connection failure
Captured boot_id 6aa805ba..., uptime, localrepo-http active, repo HTTP 200, tree installed, repo file and directory contents present

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Backgrounded systemctl reboot returned ack immediately; subsequent polls showed connection timeout/reset during reboot, then new boot_id b803b58b... and reset uptime, proving an actual restart

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of services and data
evidence.summary: After restart: localrepo-http.service active and enabled, repo HTTP 200, tree package still installed and running, repo file persisted, dnf repolist shows localrepo, firewall direct rules empty as expected (runtime-only)
